findings.text: the new falsifier discriminates on room/width narrowing rather than on the cut never-hitting-the-predicate property at the same room: with today's 48-column reason room the predicate clause is 46 columns, so a regression that kept the room but changed the cut to a blind prefix elide would keep the clause intact and the test stays green (verified: emulating a hard prefix cut at the current room leaves 'the process is gone without a complete manifest' present). The narrow-fields regression that genuinely fails the test is the one that re-adds a cell ahead of the reason (verified via a single_clause capped at 40). The plan's own measure ties the assertion to the measured pane width; this test pins the fixed 180-column grid root instead, which is the stricter surrogate (at the 208 pane the reason holds 69) but is not the pane itself.

justifications.durability: the new falsifier exists and genuinely fires: under an emulated narrowed-field regression (single_clause capped at 40 columns) test_a_reason_clipped_at_the_margin_keeps_its_predicate_clause fails, so a later change that re-spends the reason's room is caught; the plan/evidence edit passes tests/test_schema.py::test_byte_identity_on_real_reckon_plans at the reviewed head. Docked one because the discriminator resolves on room width, not on the cut-lands-after-predicate mechanism at the same room: at the current 48-column room the 46-column predicate survives even a blind prefix cut, so a same-room cut regression would stay green; and the assertion pins the fixed 180-column grid rather than the measured 208-column pane, semantic drift from the measure's wording.
justifications.evidence: independently re-ran the gate at the reviewed head 8891cfa in the reviewed worktree: tests/test_crew_ticker.py + tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py gave 88 passed, 0 failed (/tmp/rev_reason_after.log), matching the manifest's after_suite; test_schema byte-identity 1 passed (/tmp/rev_reason_schema.log); the manifest's 63->64 layout count is exact (63 def-test at 94605dd, 64 at 8891cfa); ruff adds no finding on the changed file (1=1 baseline vs head); the reviewed worktree is clean at head and base 94605dd is an ancestor. Docked one because the manifest's baseline suite was a piped run whose log was not saved (log_digest 'not saved'), so the pre-change layout count is asserted rather than stored.
justifications.fit: the falsifier sits immediately below its established sibling test_a_reason_that_fits_is_printed_whole, uses the file's own grid fixture, plain(), _event and to_state overrides, and reuses the module's single_clause cut through the real render path; naming and the docstring describe the mechanism (a cut that collapses a testable claim into a generic liveness remark). Docked one for the fixed 180-column grid root standing in for the measured pane width the measure names, and for the same-room cut-resolution coverage already noted under durability.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the reason-survives-the-clip measure's required evidence is a reason longer than the render width losing trailing detail rather than its predicate, asserted at a width that can satisfy it; the new test asserts exactly the two legs - the long reason keeps 'the process is gone without a complete manifest' and sheds the detail after it, and a short reason renders verbatim with no ellipsis - and the pre-existing behaviour claim was verified rather than reimplemented, per the verify-don't-rebuild contract. Rendered rows at the 180 and 208 widths both keep the predicate and drop the trailing detail, so the measure holds at and beyond the asserted grid.
justifications.scope_discipline: both reviewed commits touch exactly the declared write surface - git show --name-only across 8891cfa and ba487aa lists three files (tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html, docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html), each inside the five declared write paths; the reviewed worktree is clean at the head; the node knowingly left ticker.py untouched, consistent with its verify-not-reimplement claim; both messages are conventional with bodies, no plan identifiers, no AI attribution, and the evidence-record section links to its anchor by the project-absolute id.
